note: Expected drops per 100 deployment points an enemy fleet loses, then times battle difficulty (capped at 3x, scaled by difficulty_scaling: 1 = full, 0 = ignored) and the fleet's loot multipliers. A linear drop scales 1:1; a diminishing one runs at full rate up to 3000 DP in one battle and grows with the square root of DP past it.
